uutiset.t: Hansen ruled out of Ireland's clash with Australia due to injury
uutiset.s: Mack Hansen has been ruled out of Ireland's starting XV to face Australia in this Friday's Nations Championship finals clash.

uutiset.t: Why do teams mark man-to-man? Watch Affengruber's masterclass against Haaland
uutiset.s: The sight of Matthijs de Ligt, arms outstretched in disbelief at the lack of cover as Alexander Isak raced away from him, immediately felt symbolic. The Dutchman is only 27 years old but this looked like a zonal defender now living in a man-to-man marking world.

uutiset.t: Why wasn't Szoboszlai's free-kick ruled out vs Man Utd?
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino fumed over Leny Yoro's red card for Manchester United in their defeat to Liverpool, but also felt Dominik Szoboszlai's opener should not have stood – is he right?

uutiset.t: Walters confident he can win trophy in first season with St Helens
uutiset.s: Kevin Walters believes he can win a trophy with St Helens in his first season in charge, as the side's new head coach set out his ambition to restore the team's "winning DNA".

uutiset.t: Do Ferrari need to make Hamilton their No 1 driver?
uutiset.s: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton's latest run-in at the Las Vegas Grand Prix has ramped up scrutiny on Ferrari and what the team will do to try to avoid more costly on-track incidents between their two drivers.

uutiset.t: Cameron agrees contract extension with Jake Paul's MVP
uutiset.s: Chantelle Cameron, the unified super-welterweight world champion, has agreed a multi-fight extension with Jake Paul's Most Valuable Promotions.

uutiset.t: Mulder shreds Bangladesh as South Africa seal 2-0 sweep before England Tests
uutiset.s: South Africa's Wiaan Mulder followed his fifth Test century with career-best bowling figures of 7-31 as the Proteas routed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs inside three days to secure a 2-0 sweep ahead of their three-match series versus England.

uutiset.t: Khawaja 'hurt' by 'personal attacks' from Cummins in sandpaper denials
uutiset.s: Usman Khawaja has told the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast that he was "hurt" by Pat Cummins' "personal attacks" on him as the Australia Test captain explosively disputed his claims that every member of the side was aware of the use of sandpaper in 2018.

uutiset.t: Khawaja shocked by captain's comments: 'Very different to the Cummins I know'
uutiset.s: Speaking on the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast, Usman Khawaja reacts to Pat Cummins' 'Sandpapergate' press conference.

uutiset.s: It has become an era-defining rivalry in the NFL, and now the Kansas City Chiefs and Buffalo Bills will meet yet again in the biggest game of the regular season on one of football's most-watched stages.

Sterling given suspended jail sentence for dangerous driving
uutiset.s: Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway.

uutiset.t: Rinderknech denies refusing doping test and expects to be cleared
uutiset.s: France's Arthur Rinderknech is confident he will be cleared of an alleged refusal to undergo a doping test.

uutiset.t: Rodgers benched by Steelers for game with Broncos
uutiset.s: Aaron Rodgers has been benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers for Friday's game against the Denver Broncos with Mason Rudolph to start in the four-time NFL MVP's place.
